3040.title: Pair of Earrings with Four-Armed Vishnu Riding Garuda with Nagas (serpent divinities)
3040.creator: Unknown maker

source.institution: Cleveland Museum of Art, Open Access

editorial.note: Vishnu and Garuda are solar deities, and they sit on the crescent moon, so the light of both celestial bodies shines from these earrings.
